newsitem.title: FRANCE: Carrefour shares gain on buy confirmation.
newsitem.headline: Carrefour shares gain on buy confirmation.

text.p: PARIS, Aug 27 (reuter) - Shares in French supermarkets group Carrefour gained on Tuesday after brokerage and research firm Cheuvreux de Virieu confirmed the stock on its buy list, a fund manager said.
At 1348 GMT, the share was up 2.19 percent, or 60 francs, at 2,620 francs in a market while the CAC 40 index of leading shares was down 0.01 percent.
"In an important study to be published in the coming days, Cheuvreux has confirmed Carrefour on its buy list," the fund manager said.
